prompt.en: You are making a photo page for a book club. Which small mix-up do you most readily recognise?
prompt.zh: 为读书会做一页照片时，你更容易认出哪种小乌龙？

label.en: The finished page lands in the folder for a different book.
label.zh: 页面做好了，却放进另一本书的文件夹。

label.en: You use the cover draft from before the group changed its choice.
label.zh: 用了小组更换封面之前的那版草稿。

label.en: The page is ready, but the link that lets the group open it is missing.
label.zh: 页面已经做好，却漏了让大家打开的链接。

label.en: The page prints as a tiny thumbnail because its scale was mixed up.
label.zh: 打印比例弄串了，整页变成一张小缩略图。

prompt.en: A club is putting up a simple event poster. Which harmless snag sounds most familiar?
prompt.zh: 兴趣小组准备贴一张活动海报，哪种小岔子更熟悉？

label.en: The exported poster still has the wording from before the date was revised.
label.zh: 导出的还是改日期之前那版文字。

label.en: The poster has the title and date, but the room number was left out.
label.zh: 标题和日期都有，却漏了房间号。

label.en: The same poster batch gets printed twice.
label.zh: 同一批海报多打印了一遍。

label.en: Both helpers thought the other one was bringing the posters.
label.zh: 两位帮忙的人都以为海报由对方带来。

prompt.en: You are getting a board game ready for a relaxed afternoon. Which mix-up rings a bell?
prompt.zh: 准备一个轻松下午的桌游时，哪种乌龙让你有点印象？

label.en: The board and pieces arrive, but the cards that start the game do not.
label.zh: 带了棋盘和棋子，却少了开局要用的卡牌。

label.en: There are two copies of the same score pad in the box.
label.zh: 盒子里装了两份相同的记分纸。

label.en: You set out supplies for five tables when the note meant five players.
label.zh: 便签写五位玩家，却按五桌准备了用品。

label.en: You bring the neighbouring box: a different game with a similar label.
label.zh: 拿了旁边标签相似、内容却不同的另一盒游戏。

prompt.en: Friends are making paper badges for fun. Which small mistake feels easiest to recognise?
prompt.zh: 朋友一起做纸徽章玩，哪种小失误更容易认出来？

label.en: One participant gets two identical name cards.
label.zh: 给同一位参与者做了两张一样的名卡。

label.en: A strip is cut in centimetres when the template uses millimetres.
label.zh: 模板用毫米，纸条却照着厘米剪了。

label.en: Each helper assumed the other had agreed who would bring the supplies.
label.zh: 两位帮忙的人都以为对方已约好谁带材料。

label.en: The printed badges use the old template from before the lettering changed.
label.zh: 徽章打印的是改字样之前的旧模板。

prompt.en: A few friends exchange small potted plants. Which ordinary mix-up is most recognisable?
prompt.zh: 几个朋友交换小盆栽，哪种普通乌龙更有印象？

label.en: You make labels for twelve pots when the plan meant twelve pairs.
label.zh: 计划是十二对盆栽，却只按十二盆做了标签。

label.en: Two friends each thought the other had written the plant labels.
label.zh: 两位朋友都以为植物标签由对方写好了。

label.en: The label for one plant ends up on a different pot.
label.zh: 一棵植物的标签贴到了另一盆上。

label.en: The written labels are packed, but the blank tags they attach to are not.
label.zh: 写好的标签带了，却漏了用来贴标签的空白小牌。

prompt.en: You are arranging a short, shared playlist. Which little mishap sounds closest to one you recognise?
prompt.zh: 一起整理一份短歌单时，哪种小岔子更像你能认出的情况？

label.en: Both contributors thought the other had saved the final arrangement.
label.zh: 两位参与者都以为最后的排序由对方保存了。

label.en: The playlist is added to the wrong club folder.
label.zh: 歌单加进了另一个兴趣小组的文件夹。

label.en: The link points to yesterday’s order rather than the revised sequence.
label.zh: 链接指向的是昨天的顺序，不是刚调整的那版。

label.en: The same short audio sample appears twice.
label.zh: 同一段短音频在列表里出现了两次。

prompt.en: You are preparing a tiny puzzle-card set. Which harmless mix-up do you notice yourself recognising?
prompt.zh: 准备一小套谜题卡时，哪种无害乌龙更有似曾相识感？

label.en: The backs are filed with the cards for another round.
label.zh: 卡背被归进了另一轮游戏的卡牌组。

label.en: The printout uses the copy from before a typo was corrected.
label.zh: 打印的是改错字之前的那份。

label.en: The cards are finished, but the marker for the starting player is missing.
label.zh: 卡牌完成了，却少了标出起始玩家的小标记。

label.en: A page-size setting shrinks cards that were meant to fill a larger sheet.
label.zh: 纸张尺寸设置弄串，原本要铺满大纸的卡牌都缩小了。

prompt.en: A shared sketchbook is ready to show the group. Which small snag sounds most familiar?
prompt.zh: 一本共作速写册要给大家看了，哪种小岔子更熟悉？

label.en: The scan is from before the latest edits were added.
label.zh: 扫描的还是最新修改之前那版。

label.en: The pages are drawn, but the numbers needed to read them in order are missing.
label.zh: 页面画好了，却漏了帮助按顺序阅读的页码。

label.en: One finished page is included twice.
label.zh: 同一张完成的页面收进去了两次。

label.en: Each friend thought the other was posting the link for the group.
label.zh: 两位朋友都以为册子的链接由对方发给大家。

prompt.en: You are helping organise a small book-swap shelf. Which mix-up is easiest to relate to?
prompt.zh: 帮忙整理小型换书架时，哪种乌龙更容易理解？

label.en: The books arrive, but the index cards for finding them are still at home.
label.zh: 书带到了，用来查找的索引卡却留在家里。

label.en: Two index cards are made for the same book.
label.zh: 给同一本书做了两张索引卡。

label.en: You prepare ten bookmarks when the note meant ten pairs.
label.zh: 便签要十对书签，却只准备了十张。

label.en: A book goes onto the shelf for a different subject.
label.zh: 书放上了另一个主题的书架。

prompt.en: A hobby group is laying out a few seats for an informal session. Which little mishap rings a bell?
prompt.zh: 兴趣小组给一次轻松活动摆几个座位，哪种小乌龙有印象？

label.en: The same invitation is sent out twice.
label.zh: 同一份活动邀请多发了一次。

label.en: A note about ten seats is copied as ten tables.
label.zh: 关于十个座位的便签，被记成了十张桌子。

label.en: Each helper thought the other had brought the paper table mats.
label.zh: 两位帮忙的人都以为桌上的纸垫由对方带了。

label.en: The layout still follows the version from before the group reduced its numbers.
label.zh: 摆法还是小组减少人数之前的那版。

prompt.en: You are finishing a small cardboard display box. Which harmless snag is most recognisable?
prompt.zh: 给一个小纸板展示盒收尾时，哪种无害岔子更熟悉？

label.en: A measurement is copied in the wrong unit, so the lid comes out too large.
label.zh: 尺寸抄成了另一种单位，盒盖做大了。

label.en: Both makers thought the other had told the group about the changed layout.
label.zh: 两位制作者都以为布局变了这件事由对方通知了大家。

label.en: The right label is attached to the neighbouring display box.
label.zh: 标签内容没错，却贴在旁边的展示盒上。

label.en: The box is finished without the small tab needed to close it.
label.zh: 盒子做完了，却少了让它合上的小插舌。

prompt.en: A club newsletter is ready to circulate. Which everyday mix-up feels most familiar?
prompt.zh: 一份兴趣小组简报准备发出，哪种日常乌龙更熟悉？

label.en: Both editors thought the other was pressing Send.
label.zh: 两位编辑都以为发送这一步由对方完成。

label.en: The public newsletter goes to the test list rather than the club list.
label.zh: 公开简报发到了测试名单，而不是小组名单。

label.en: The attached draft is the older copy from before the final edits.
label.zh: 附件还是最终修改之前的旧稿。

label.en: The same event notice appears twice on the page.
label.zh: 页面里同一条活动通知出现了两遍。

title.zh: 完整选项与主题对应表

paragraphs.en: For independent recounting, the following key maps option positions 1–4 to the six themes. Positions follow the displayed top-to-bottom order in each question, in both languages. Add one to the named theme for your selected position; do not add points to unselected options.
paragraphs.zh: 如需自己复算，下表把每题第1—4个选项对应到六个主题。答位在两种语言中均按题目从上到下的显示顺序。每题只给所选答位对应的主题加1次，未选选项不加分。

paragraphs.en: Question 1 — options in displayed order: 1: Wrong Target; 2: Wrong Version; 3: One Thing Left Out; 4: Mixed-up Amount.
paragraphs.zh: 第1题——按显示顺序对应：1: 对象错位; 2: 版本拿错; 3: 漏了一项; 4: 数量串台。
